note_prompt: Observations only, counts and recency, at most 80 words; one shared notebook per history.
primary: Per-history post-switch mean loss of frozen-read/model-bet minus fresh-read/model-bet, averaged over the 48 changed histories. Positive means fresh reads help.
success: 95% paired history-bootstrap interval above zero, and positive mean advantage in each switch direction. All 96 histories must complete.
secondary: Fixed calculator with the same notes read; exact recent counts with the same calculator; raw-history read with the same calculator; unchanged opponents; own-choice games; basic skills. Descriptive, not additional confirmatory tests.
failure_policy: Truncated/invalid notes retain prior note. Invalid reads retain prior read, initially 50%. Invalid actions check. Transport failures retry up to six times then stop resumably. Wrong model alias aborts. Failures are counted, never discarded.
cache: Exact request cache at temperature zero; cached duplicates are not independent replications.
quiz: 240 counting questions plus 960 betting questions; numeric, sentence and supplied-payoff variants, each with and without a hand-strength label.
splits: Counting is development. All controlled and own-choice histories are held out. Betting quiz: every fourth situation group is held out; all representations and label variants stay together. Training-candidate boards have highest rank Q/K, held-out boards T/J; preflight boards A.
grading: Exact one-decision expected net bb against scripted call/fold probabilities; includes half the existing pot contributed by hero. No claim about counterfactual multi-hand trajectories.
scope: River drills. Hand strength supplied in main and online experiments. Opponent always has top pair. Observed responses independent of hero cards. This does not establish full-table learning or a fine-tuning benefit.
